basis: Standard Middle Egyptian formulae as taught in A. H. Gardiner, Egyptian Grammar (3rd ed. 1957), Excursus B (the offering formula) and §§ on royal titulary, and J. P. Allen, Middle Egyptian (3rd ed. 2014), Lessons 6 and 24. These are composite teaching forms, not quotations of single monuments.

phrases.text: ḥtp dj nswt wsjr nb ḏdw nṯr ꜥꜣ nb ꜣbḏw
phrases.english: An offering that the king gives (to) Osiris, lord of Busiris, great god, lord of Abydos
phrases.swahili: Sadaka ambayo mfalme anatoa (kwa) Osiris, bwana wa Busiris, mungu mkuu, bwana wa Abydos

phrases.text: ḥtp dj nswt jnpw tpj ḏw.f
phrases.english: An offering that the king gives (to) Anubis who is upon his mountain
phrases.swahili: Sadaka ambayo mfalme anatoa (kwa) Anubis aliye juu ya mlima wake

phrases.text: dj.f prt-ḫrw t ḥnqt kꜣ ꜣpd šs mnḫt ḫt nb nfr wꜥb
phrases.english: that he may give an invocation offering of bread, beer, cattle, fowl, alabaster, linen and every good and pure thing
phrases.swahili: ili atoe sadaka ya kuitwa: mkate, bia, ng'ombe, ndege, alabasta, kitani na kila kitu kizuri na safi

phrases.text: ḫt nb nfr wꜥb ꜥnḫ nṯr jm
phrases.english: every good and pure thing on which a god lives
phrases.swahili: kila kitu kizuri na safi ambacho mungu huishi kwacho

phrases.english: for the ka of the revered one
phrases.swahili: kwa ajili ya ka ya mheshimiwa

phrases.text: n kꜣ n jmꜣḫ ḫr nṯr ꜥꜣ
phrases.english: for the ka of the one revered before the great god
phrases.swahili: kwa ajili ya ka ya mheshimiwa mbele ya mungu mkuu

phrases.english: given life, stability and dominion forever
phrases.swahili: aliyepewa uhai, uthabiti na mamlaka milele

phrases.english: dual king, lord of the two lands
phrases.swahili: mfalme wa Misri ya Juu na ya Chini, bwana wa nchi mbili

phrases.english: son of Re, lord of appearances
phrases.swahili: mwana wa Ra, bwana wa kutokea kwa utukufu

phrases.english: An offering that the king gives
invocation offering (lit. 'going forth of the voice')
